answer_1.quote: We also assess the performance of InfoPO on summarization and dialogue generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: text responses to prompts including reasoning solutions, code, summaries, and dialogue

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we evaluate methods fine-tuned on UltraFeedback Binarized on the HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard and instruction-following benchmark (AlpacaEval2). We also utilize representative code generation benchmarks: HumanEval and MBPP.

answer_3.quote: For the evaluation on summarization and dialogue generation tasks, we use GPT-4 for zero-shot pair-wise evaluation following, which is shown to be consistent with human judgments.
